newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clal Israel gets offers for Clal Trading shares.
newsitem.headline: Clal Israel gets offers for Clal Trading shares.

text.p: Clal Israel Ltd said in a statement it has received offers to buy 88 percent of all outstanding shares in Clal Trading Ltd.

This follows Clal Israel's offer to buy all of the shares in its subsidiary for 8.75 shekels a share, a premium of 37.4 percent above the Tel Aviv market price when the offer was first made on August 21.
At the time Clal Israel, one of Israel's largest conglomerates, said it hoped to buy over 90 percent of the outstanding shares in order delist the company.
"The stock will continue to trade on the Tel Aviv market until we have an opportunity to purchase the remaining shares," a Clal spokesman said.
Clal Trading is a service company that sells drugs, toys, computers and watches.
